d:
After the biggest superhit romantic songs of 2014 - Saanson Ko and Tu Zaroori - comes yet another Bollywood chartbuster from Zid – Mareez-e-Ishq. Arijit Singh’s soulful voice is sure to
make you fall in love all over again!
Song Credits:
Song Name: Mareez - E - Ishq
Movie: Zid
Singer: Arijit Singh
Lyrics: Shakeel Azmi
Music Composer: Sharib - Toshi
